title: Colombia’s Trump-Endorsed President-Elect Was Once Investigated by U.S. Authorities
summary: Colombia’s president-elect, a lawyer, represented accused drug traffickers, among others. While living in Miami, he himself was investigated by U.S. authorities, though never charged.
